verdict.rationale: Notion publishes a full REST API with OpenAPI spec, official SDK-style access via internal/public connections and PATs, an official MCP server/client guides, webhooks, and Agent APIs with SDK-like session/streaming semantics — all documented first-party and confirmed by live probes (openapi.json, llms.txt, MCP docs). Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of SDK usage and no explicit mention of language-specific official SDK libraries (only REST/OpenAPI + MCP tooling), so some ambiguity remains on 'official SDK' vs REST/OpenAPI wrapper.
